task.problem: BP-0 audit proved a generic TOCTOU/intent-binding gap in the current PRIMARY remote wakeup path. TASK-108's Issue carrier sanitizes one authorization to dispatch_id/task_id/executor; A1 forwards only those three values; A2 persists and collision-checks only task_id/executor; and bind_dispatch_run validates an admitted RUN against task id/executor but not the authorized TASK revision. TASK-062 then safely synchronizes local main before TASK loading. Consequently, if the same TASK id is revised after remote authorization but before self-host admission, the old wakeup may execute the newer TASK semantics. The resulting RUN truthfully records what actually executed, but the outer authorization does not prove that those semantics were what Human/Brain authorized. This is a control-plane intent-binding defect, not a Runtime, Executor, verification, or publication defect.
